TA0038.title: Underground Money Houses
TA0038.description: Underground money houses are organizations that provide illegal currency exchange, cross-border fund transfer, and money-laundering services without approval from financial regulators. Unlike TA0014 money laundering rooms, which primarily split, aggregate, and move criminal proceeds within one country, these actors organize settlement between domestic and overseas fund pools for a fee; they do not directly conduct their clients' fraud, automation attacks, or denial-of-service attacks. Typical methods include mirror settlement between separately controlled fund pools, sham trade or cross-border e-commerce transactions, over-the-counter cryptocurrency conversion and mixing services, and layered transfers through personal accounts, corporate accounts, and intermediaries. Their operations directly create money-laundering risk and can support cryptocurrency laundering and illegal cash-out activities.
